comment: Material of A-1 (doc/megaliths/A1_MONOLITH.md). Generated by tools/blender/megalith_a_monolith.py; the Blender node tree in the .blend is the reference implementation.
projection: box (triplanar) in object space, blend 0.15; hard pixels (nearest)

hatch.what: red hatched stone: strokes and a wobbly broken groove grid

grooves.what: soft mask of the hatch grooves (same layout as hatch)

vertex_attributes._EDGE: 1 around step faces (ledges, block edges, corners), fades across faces

per_object: Object Info Random: noise offset (x731, x377) and coverage nudge
layers: stone = hatch, darkened by stretched-noise streaks, slow light/dark drift (noise 0.012/m), dulled toward brown (stone_saturation, stone_value), pale strokes mixed in (scratch_strength)

moss mask = stepped(snap moss_pixel_m) banded noise (z stretched moss_streak_stretch) + foot (below moss_foot_m) + up-facing ledges + _EDGE*moss_edge_weight + fine fray (moss_ragged) + per-object nudge, thresholded at 1.15-moss_coverage +- moss_softness; max with grooves seeping (warped groove mask gated by the noise)
base colour = mix(stone, moss, mask) x shape AO x cavity
height = strokes*stroke_height - grooves*(1-mask)*groove_depth + mask*(0.45+moss luma)*moss_height -> bump normal (bump_strength, bump_distance_m)
roughness = stone_roughness / stroke_roughness on strokes / moss_roughness under moss; specular knob
